name: InitMpegLibrary
evidence: the MPEG library's initialisation: resets the IPU (ResetIpu) (InitMoviePlayback calls it)

name: CreateMpegDecoder
evidence: sets up a decoder in a work area, reporting "The size of work area is too small" when it is, with its ring buffer and DMA hooks (InitMoviePlayback calls it)

name: DeleteMpegDecoder
evidence: returns 1 (FinishMovie calls it)

name: DecodeMpegPicture
evidence: sets the output address and size of a decoder and runs its picture loop (StepMovieFrame calls it)

name: GetMpegDecoderStatus
evidence: returns the first word of a decoder's state (PlayMovie reads it)

name: ResetMpegDecoder
evidence: clears a decoder's state words and its pictures' bookkeeping (FinishMovie and CreateMpegDecoder call it)

name: ReleaseMpegPictures
evidence: clears the word at +0x28 of each of the decoder's six picture pointers that is set

name: SetMpegCallback
evidence: stores a callback and its argument in a decoder's table at an index and returns the old one (InitMoviePlayback calls it)

name: RunMpegCallback
evidence: runs the decoder's callback for the kind a message names, with its argument

name: RunMpegStallCallback
evidence: runs the decoder's callback of kind 1; the IPU waits call it each time the IPU stays busy too long

name: InitMpegRing
evidence: sets a ring buffer's start, size, read and write positions

name: MarkMpegRing
evidence: copies a ring buffer's word at +8 into its word at +0xC, a mark CreateMpegDecoder sets after the ring is made

name: RewindMpegRingToMark
evidence: copies a ring buffer's word at +0xC into its word at +8, going back to the mark MarkMpegRing took (the picture buffer allocation calls it)

name: AllocateFromMpegRing
evidence: takes an aligned block of a size from a decoder's ring buffer, reporting an error when it does not fit

name: RunMpegPictureLoop
evidence: the decoder's picture loop: parses headers and decodes pictures until a picture is out or the stream ends (DecodeMpegPicture calls it)

name: DecodeFramePicture
evidence: the picture loop's step for a picture whose structure is 3: selects the output picture, decodes its data when its number is below the limit, runs the stall callback when it is not, and advances the picture counters

name: DecodePictureByStructure
evidence: runs DecodeFieldPicture when the current picture's structure is not 3 and DecodeFramePicture when it is

name: DecodeFieldPicture
evidence: the picture loop's step for a field picture: decodes the first field, parses the headers up to the second field's and decodes it, and returns -1 when the second field's structure is wrong

name: FlushPendingPicture
evidence: when a picture has been decoded and is waiting, outputs it with OutputPendingPicture, records its size in the owner and clears the waiting flag, returning 1

name: ResetMpegPictureMode
evidence: clears a word of the decoder's state at +0x848 and sets the IPU to MPEG-1 mode with SetIpuMpeg1Mode(1) (ResetMpegDecoder calls it)

name: OutputPendingPicture
evidence: outputs the decoded picture by its structure, with OutputFramePicture for 3 and OutputFieldPicturePair otherwise, reporting "the second field is missing" when a second field is still expected

name: SetUpMpegScratchpadBuffers
evidence: sets the IPU to MPEG-1 mode and points the decoder's two pictures' buffers at 0x70000000, +0x1800, +0x1B00 and +0x3300 in the scratchpad (CreateMpegDecoder calls it)

name: ResetMpegDmaAndIpu
evidence: with interrupts disabled, clears the control registers of the IPU's DMA channels 3, 4 and 8, resets the IPU (0x40000000 into its control register) and waits for it with SyncIpu

name: PrintMpegError
evidence: prints a message after "[MPEG ERROR]"

name: ReportMpegErrorFormat
evidence: formats a message into a buffer and reports it with ReportMpegError

name: ReportMpegError
evidence: hands a message to the decoder's callback of kind 0, or prints it with PrintMpegError when there is none

name: SetPictureDimensions
evidence: stores a width and height and the same divided by 16, the dimensions in macroblocks (AllocatePictureBuffers calls it for each picture buffer)

name: ReadSequenceHeader
evidence: reads a sequence header and its extensions (ParseMpegHeaders calls it on the start code 0x1B3)

name: AllocatePictureBuffers
evidence: original assembly: after a sequence header, when the width or height in macroblocks changed, rewinds the ring, allocates three 64-byte aligned picture buffers from it, fills the pictures' plane addresses with SetUpPictureBufferAddresses and sets each plane's dimensions

name: SetUpPictureBufferAddresses
evidence: fills the addresses of a picture's luma and two chroma planes for both halves from three buffer addresses, the second half starting at a macroblock count times 0x180 into each, as uncached addresses

name: LoadIpuQuantiserMatrix
evidence: runs the callback with kinds 2 and 3 around a DMA of a 64-byte matrix to the IPU through channel 4 followed by a command (0x50000000 or 0x58000000 from the caller), waiting for the IPU each step (ReadSequenceHeader calls it for the default matrices)

name: ReadSequenceExtension
evidence: reads the sequence extension: the profile and level (reporting "Unsupported profile/level"), the chroma format (it must be 420) and the high bits of the width, height and bit rate

name: ReadSequenceDisplayExtension
evidence: reads the sequence display extension: a 3-bit format, an optional colour description of three bytes, and two 14-bit display sizes

name: RejectSequenceScalableExtension
evidence: reports "_sequenceScalableExtension() is not implemented"

name: RejectUnknownExtension
evidence: reports "Unknown Extension"

name: RejectSpatialScalableExtension
evidence: reports "_pictureSpatialScalableExtension is not supported"

name: RejectTemporalScalableExtension
evidence: reports "_pictureTemporalScalableExtension is not supported"

name: SaveMpegDmaState
evidence: saves the IPU's two DMA channels before a picture (SaveIpuDmaChannels); a decoder's hook

name: RestoreMpegDmaState
evidence: restores the IPU's two DMA channels after a picture (RestoreIpuDmaChannels); a decoder's hook
